title: I built a multiplayer museum heist game solo — now I'm looking for playtesters!
author: TheHeistGameSupport
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I've been solo developing with Opus 5.5 **The Heist**, a 4–10 player multiplayer social deduction game set inside a museum.

The idea is simple: **steal priceless artifacts, outsmart security, and escape without getting caught.**

But there's a twist — everyone has a role.

Some players are trying to steal, others are protecting the museum, and some have their own objectives.

The game currently features:

* 9 different roles
* Hacking, traps, and security systems
* Valuable artifacts to steal and carry
* Multiple escape routes
* Social deduction, deception, and unexpected betrayals

I've spent a lot of time building this project on my own, and I've reached the point where I really need actual players to test it.

**I'm looking for playtesters** to help me figure out what's fun, what's confusing, and what needs improvement — especially role balance and multiplayer gameplay.

The video shows actual footage from the game.

If you're interested in testing The Heist, leave a comment or send me a DM!

Thanks for checking out my game. Every bit of support means a lot to me as a solo developer. ❤️
